note: The authoritative NeoUse source enumerates 14 commands. Request prose saying 15 is treated as a count typo; WebHelm must reject any extra command rather than invent contract behavior.

commands.effect: red target box, clears tooltip, captures frame
animated cursor endpoint on composed output
reset timeline and begin CDP capture first
end timeline then compose and validate artifacts

result.video_recorded: true only after valid H.264 capture, ffprobe and Markcut verify, plus render validation when requested

target_resolution.fresh_ref: unique snapshot-generation data-ref from the current snapshot and active target
target_resolution.label: case-insensitive accessible-label substring among visible interactive nodes
target_resolution.browser_effects: Runtime.evaluate read only; no overlay DOM, focus, clicks, or style mutation

timing.relative_time: performance.now() monotonic milliseconds from recording start
timing.relative_origin: start_recording receipt after screencast is live
timing.capture_start: before start_recording returns and before any later Demo event

browser_differences: Viewport CSS pixels replace iOS screen points; capture metadata may be scaled.
CDP Page.screencastFrame emits changed real tab frames; the daemon streams the latest real frame into a live FFmpeg encoder at requested cadence to preserve real-time duration.
The owned active tab is brought to foreground during capture so Chrome renders its screencast.
Overlays are added by daemon-owned FFmpeg composition, not an OS-level layer.
macOS say plus AAC narration replaces iOS-side voice behavior; --no-voice omits it and Markcut verification still runs.
artifacts: markcut/assets/voice-*.m4a when say and voice enabled
isolation: only active WebHelm Session target is resolved or captured
screencast callback is bound by CDP sessionId
second Session/tab receives no Demo mutation
stop, close, expiry and capture failure dispose capture and listener without unrelated tab closure
